what: Semtech makes analogue and mixed-signal chips: the transceivers that move data over copper and fibre in data centres, circuit protection, and the LoRa radio technology used by long-range sensors.
customers: Data centre equipment makers, telecom operators, carmakers and industrial sensor manufacturers.
money: data centre and optical transceivers and retimers
moat: LoRa is a de facto standard for long-range low-power sensor networks, and its data centre copper interconnect chips are designed into platforms years ahead.
risks: A reported operating loss after write-downs on the Sierra Wireless acquisition
opportunities: Revenue grew from $741M to $1.0B in four years with $184M of free cash flow
Analysts see about 102% upside, with 15 covering the stock
Data centre copper interconnect demand is rising with AI cluster build-outs, which is its best business
watch: Data centre segment revenue and the gross margin.
